label: Qwik City 1.20 (express adapter)
streaming: streamed (Qwik renderToStream, chunked transfer; route loaders resolve before rendering starts)
notes: Deviation: qwikCity({ trailingSlash: false }) in vite.config.ts (documented option, default true). With the default, GET /items answers 301 → /items/ and every link/redirect targets slash URLs; the contract's URLs are /items and /items/:id.

Server: src/entry.express.tsx exactly as generated by `npm run qwik add express` (Qwik City 1.20.4): express 4 + express.static for /build and /assets (immutable, 1y) and dist/, then the Qwik City node middleware, then its notFound handler. Listens on process.env.PORT on all interfaces (HOST is not read). Loads dotenv/config at start (no .env file present).

No compression: the generated entry ships `app.use(compression())` commented out; the compression package is installed by the adapter but unused. Responses are identity even with Accept-Encoding: gzip/br.

Per request: express routing + static-file lookup miss in dist/, Qwik City request handler (route match, routeLoader$ → one listItems()/getItem() await), SSR via renderToStream including serialising loader state into qwik/json (/items HTML ~77 KB). POST checks the Origin header (CSRF, default on) against the request's own origin since ORIGIN is unset.
Not-found: the documented routeLoader$ pattern `requestEvent.fail(404, { errorMessage })`; the page renders the message with HTTP 404.

Form: routeAction$ with no zod$ — validateName(data.name) is the rule; invalid → fail(400, { error }) rendered in

; valid → addItem then `throw redirect(302, /items/:id)`.

works without JS (full POST) and is intercepted with JS.

Resumable: no mark is emitted. The page ships qwikloader inline plus the 1.x preloader: three <link rel=modulepreload> for /build chunks, one <script type=module async> preloader and a <link rel=preload as=fetch> of the bundle-graph JSON. No service worker is registered (the 1.20 `empty` starter ships none).
Build also emits dist/404.html and dist/sitemap.xml (Qwik City defaults); /items and /items/:id are not prerendered (no onStaticGenerate).
